messages.subject: Save progress and resume at another instance
parts:
I am interested in creating a questionnaire then do analysis based on the input data. Because of the number of questions the user may have to save their progress and resume later.

Does shiny web framework allow for that functionality (saving a workspace and then resuming)? If not could someone recommend another system I can integrate with the shiny web framework?
